problem.label: The problem
problem.description: Every day, hundreds of businesses in Italy receive complaints, fines and warnings for emission problems. This means stress, unexpected costs and, in the worst cases, business closure.
problem.visibleSmokeDesc: Smoke coming from the chimney attracts complaints from neighbours.
problem.neighborComplaintsDesc: Unpleasant odours invading surrounding homes create tensions in the neighbourhood.
problem.aslControlsDesc: Increasingly frequent inspections with risk of fines and temporary closures.
problem.reputationDamageDesc: Negative online reviews mentioning 'smell' and 'smoke' harm the business.
problem.finesDesc: Fines up to €5,000 for non-compliance with emission regulations.
problem.closureRiskDesc: In severe cases, authorities can order the cessation of business activities.

howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.description: ZAPPER® uses a three-phase process to guarantee clean air and regulatory compliance without compromise.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Smoke is extracted directly from the source before it can disperse into the environment.
howItWorks.step2Desc: A multi-stage filter system retains particles, grease and odours with 95% efficiency.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Purified air is released into the atmosphere, complying with all current regulations.

professional.label: Professional Sector
professional.description: We manufacture series-produced machines to optimise the quality-price ratio. Each model is standardised based on capacity and type of smoke to abate: from pizzerias to bakeries, from grill houses to professional kitchens.
professional.socialProof: Chosen by leading restaurants and businesses

uta.label: Activated Carbon AHU
uta.description: Our activated carbon AHUs are designed for standard applications in the professional and industrial sectors. They guarantee effective abatement of odours, VOCs and gaseous pollutants through high-efficiency activated carbon filtration, in a modular and easily integrable format.
uta.imageCaption: 🇮🇹 Activated carbon filtration — Standard professional and industrial applications

industrial.label: Industrial Sector
industrial.description: We design and build customised abatement systems for high-capacity industrial plants. Each machine is sized to the specific needs of your production process, effectively treating dust, NOx, CO₂, SOx, VOCs and other specific pollutants.
industrial.imageCaption: 🇮🇹 Designed and built entirely in Italy — Made in Italy
industrial.socialProof: Chosen by leading companies in the industrial sector
